page.layout: One printed title page, centred; a woodcut of a winged horse in the middle; no running text, no notes in the margins.
page.notes: Woodcut of a winged horse (Pegasus) between the title and the imprint. Red oval seal at left and blue library stamp at lower right are not transcribed. A pencilled mark at top right is not transcribed. The small mark after the date is a printer's ornament or stop and is not transcribed.
